svg.title: E. Badge for level 1, sign for level 2
svg.desc: Level 1 is a quiet dot; level 2 (the risky one) gets the sign. Recommended. Letter shape: Mac/Assets.xcassets/MenuBarGlyph.imageset/r-mask.png. Icon canvas 18 pt, shown at 4x (72px).

text.font-family: -apple-system, SF Pro Text, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
